sql:
SELECT
    p.BrandName,
    sum(s.SalesAmount) AS TotalRevenue,
    sum(s.TotalCost) AS TotalCost,
    sum(s.SalesAmount - s.TotalCost) AS GrossProfit
FROM retail.FactSales AS s
JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
WHERE toQuarter(s.DateKey) = toQuarter(today() - INTERVAL 1 QUARTER)
  AND toYear(s.DateKey) = toYear(today() - INTERVAL 1 QUARTER)
GROUP BY p.BrandName
ORDER BY GrossProfit DESC
